title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Soda Blue Razz Lemonade Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Everyone’s favourite fruit slushy blend gets the Doozy Vape Co treatment in this unmissable soda e-liquid. Rich, tangy Raspberry and succulent, sweet Blueberry play together beautifully in this sweet, syrupy blend that’s lifted with a zesty burst of lemonade on the exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette vape starter kits and pod vape devices . Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
